summary: preinstall script exfiltrates installer environment and filesystem data to webhook.site
details: hunterone-build-probe-9210 runs a preinstall script (probe.js) that automatically executes on `npm install`. The script collects installer-side data — current working directory, a recursive listing of /tmp, /proc/uptime, and AWS Lambda environment variables scraped from /proc/2/environ (AWS_LAMBDA_FUNCTION_NAME, AWS_LAMBDA_LOG_STREAM_NAME, etc.) — and POSTs the collected JSON to a hardcoded attacker-controlled collector at https://webhook.site/5711fe0a-6437-47ae-9fd0-75d624c26467/shared. Reading /proc/2/environ scrapes another process's environment to fingerprint cloud/CI execution contexts (notably AWS Lambda build environments). The behavior fires at install time without any user action beyond installing the package.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
